profile.name: Mohit Lamba
profile.subTitle: Backend + AI systems
profile.headline: The interesting work starts after the request leaves the browser.
profile.availabilityStatus: Open for high-scale backend engineering & AI infrastructure roles
bioParagraphs: I'm a full-stack developer who ended up specializing in the harder half of the stack: backend systems and AI infrastructure. I like problems where the interesting part isn't the UI — it's what happens after the request leaves the browser.

At EY, I helped build a WhatsApp engagement platform that now serves 5M+ users — the kind of scale where every shortcut you take in the backend eventually finds you. That's where I learned to care about reliability, not just features.
These days I split my time between agentic AI — LangGraph, LangChain, autonomous workflows — and distributed backend systems that need to survive unpredictable load bursts.

experiences.description: Architected and scaled conversational intelligence and high-throughput messaging infrastructure handling mission-critical enterprise workflows.
bullets: Architected WhatsApp engagement microservices platform processing millions of events daily with 99.98% SLA.
Engineered asynchronous queue decoupling with RabbitMQ and Redis caching, slashing p95 latency from 850ms to 92ms.
Integrated multi-agent conversational pipelines using LangGraph and LangChain for automated user verification and smart ticket triage.
Implemented resilient telemetry, Prometheus metrics, and automated alert routing for proactive failure isolation.

experiences.description: Designed hybrid vector search retrieval and stateful multi-agent execution graphs for enterprise knowledge ingestion.
bullets: Built resilient RAG engine featuring contextual chunking, re-ranking with cross-encoders, and pgvector clustering.
Developed MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers allowing local tools and databases to interface securely with LLM agents.
Implemented circuit breakers, token usage budgets, and fallback chains that reduced LLM API failures by 94%.

projects.title: Agentic Graph Core
projects.tagline: Stateful multi-agent orchestration engine with dynamic branching and cyclic verification
projects.description: An asynchronous workflow engine designed for fault-tolerant LLM agent swarms. Implements checkpointing, human-in-the-loop review, and self-healing tool execution.
projects.architectureNotes: Built on top of LangGraph state machines, Redis stream queues, and PostgreSQL JSONB event-sourcing.

projects.title: Enterprise Omnichannel Relay
projects.tagline: High-concurrency webhook ingest and message dispatch engine for WhatsApp Business API
projects.description: Designed to ingest massive bursts of webhook webhooks, deduplicate incoming events, and route to distributed workers with backpressure management.
projects.architectureNotes: Asynchronous event-driven architecture using RabbitMQ, Redis sliding-window rate limiters, and cluster clustering.

projects.title: Contextual Neural Vector Index
projects.tagline: Semantic search and document intelligence engine with hybrid sparse-dense retrieval
projects.description: Hybrid vector retrieval system combining BM25 keyword matching with dense embeddings and cross-encoder re-ranking for ultra-precise citations.
projects.architectureNotes: pgvector indexed with HNSW, Redis cache for hot embeddings, and semantic cache deduping.
